doesNotClaimR2: There is no `reviews[]` entry here and there will not be one from me. R2 wants a named reviewer who is not the author, and I am the author of every path above. This migration stores per-section access marks on the events register (which gates a surface that handles children's registration data), so under the team rule it goes to the CTO, and there is no independent security reviewer on this team (board declined the seat on cost) -- a CTO self-review is a recorded degradation, not independent review. The commit carrying these compliance-path files WILL report an R2 violation until that review records its verdict, and that violation is the honest state. The compliance paths stay uncommitted until the CTO verdict lands on the AFC-871 review issue (child of AFC-871, blockedBy). Writing a `reviews[]` entry naming myself would turn a control into a rubber stamp. The AFC-871 issue also names a SecurityEngineer visibility-matrix review; that seat does not exist, which is recorded in the review request rather than implied as covered.

whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: AFC-871 slice 1 (parent AFC-460): per-section visibility + programme sections storage. Migration 20261028_0045 adds events.registration_visibility / speakers_visibility / resources_visibility / schedule_visibility (text, NOT NULL, DEFAULT private, CHECK draft/private/public/login/custom) plus events.speakers / resources / schedule (jsonb, NOT NULL, DEFAULT [], array-only CHECK), with bootstrap-role guard, migrator-ownership precondition, backfill of public marks on already-public events (guarded: re-apply never overwrites a staff-set mark), and column-level INSERT/UPDATE grants to directus_app with no DELETE change. The down script refuses (restrict_violation/23001) on staff-configured rows (login/custom/draft marks, public-on-non-public, non-empty sections) and drops otherwise. Suite 45 covers shape, enums, fail-closed default + guarded backfill, the app ceiling (42501 on DELETE, 23514 on bad marks), rerun idempotence, refusal + empty rollback + re-apply, and the public-feed predicate acceptance (open rows served, login/branch rows never pass). Shared: SECTION_VISIBILITIES enum + SectionVisibility type, four optional form fields defaulting private, toEventPayload passthrough, EventRecord section fields. Numbering: 0045, the next free sequence number (0044 held by AFC-801, 0057 held by AFC-828 in-flight).
